description: This Dart file defines the FolderDetailScreen widget for a Flutter application. It displays details of a selected folder, including its name, description, and a list/grid view of associated documents. It provides functionalities for opening, sharing, editing, and deleting documents, as well as editing folder properties. The widget interacts with repositories and services to manage data and perform actions, and uses various UI components for user interaction.

classes.name: FolderDetailScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays details for a specific folder, including its documents, and allows user interactions such as editing, deleting, sharing, and opening documents.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes repository references, sets up change stream listeners, and loads folder and documents data.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the widget is removed from the widget tree.

methods.name: _initialize
methods.description: Loads initial data and sets up change listeners for repository changes.

methods.name: _loadFolderAndDocs
methods.description: Fetches folder details and associated documents from repositories.

methods.name: _toggleLayout
methods.description: Switches between list and grid views.

methods.name: _openDocument
methods.description: Navigates to the document detail page.

methods.name: _shareDocument
methods.description: Shares a document via the ShareService.

methods.name: _deleteDocument
methods.description: Deletes a document after user confirmation, updates repositories, deletes local file, and shows a snackbar notification.

methods.name: _editDocument
methods.description: Allows editing of document name and notes, updates repository, and refreshes list.

methods.name: _promptEditDocument
methods.description: Prompts user with a dialog to edit document details.

methods.name: _renameFolder
methods.description: Allows editing of folder name and description, updates repository, and refreshes data.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the FolderDetailScreen, including app bar, body content, and document list/grid.

methods.name: _buildList
methods.description: Builds a list view of documents.

methods.name: _buildGrid
methods.description: Builds a responsive grid view of documents.

methods.name: _pickIcon
methods.description: Returns an icon based on the document's MIME type.
